messages:
misaka: quick note — bringing misaka-q4-int8 into staging for multilingual regression runs. seeing a reproducible quality drop on zh-Hant->en and odd bracket/ruby handling for ja inputs. cc @rahul @kai
rahul: can you paste a minimal repro and the eval command?
misaka: repro: src: "《源氏》の注釈：〈るい〉は…" (ja w/ ruby). eval cmd: `evaluate --model misaka-q4 --quant int8 --locales zh_Hant,ja_JP --samples 2000 --seed 42`
misaka: fp16 baseline BLEU zh_Hant->en 28.1, int8 23.9. ja seems fine. detok examples show angle brackets moved and ruby markers converted to ASCII angle bracket tokens in wrong positions.
kai: is tokenizer pipeline identical between fp16 and int8 artifacts? we usually freeze token merges but quant build step can reserialize tables.
misaka: i dumped token ids: tokenizer.encode(...) => [120, 4002, 221, 9001] (shortened). detok via model.detok(ids) yields misplaced brackets.
rahul: i suspect the quantized merge table used a different hashing seed during build (we saw this once with qconfig v3). can you run `tools/inspect_merge --artifact misaka-q4-int8 --out /tmp/mapping.json` and attach?
sora: also check normalizer/pre-tokenize flags (NFKC vs NFC). CLDR locale stripping earlier caused subtle seg differences for zh_Hant.
misaka: attached mapping gist: https://ci.redwood/gist/3456 (link)
jx-bot: nightly-eval created run 19012 for misaka-q4-int8 — quick metrics: zh_Hant BLEU drop -4.2, perplexity +9%
rahul: starting bisect across quantization commits c9a1..f2b3 to find when merge table changed.
kai: try `--no-prefix-merge` as a smoke toggle in tokenizer to see if prefix compaction is the culprit.
misaka: tried toggle: with prefix-merge off, detok looks closer to fp16 for the ruby example. suggests merge compaction introduced extra split.
rahul: confirmed: commit d4f7 rebuilt merge table with new seed -> caused U+3008/U+3009 to split differently. reproducer: `python -c "from tokenizer import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer('misaka-q4-int8', commit='d4f7'); print(t.encode('\u3008\u308b\u3044\u3009'))"` produces different ids than fp16.
sora: local fix: regenerated quantized merge table using original seed and reserialized -> detok parity restored on 500-sample check. pushing branch `pr/89-fix-merge-seed`.
rahul: plan: 1) reproduce full mapping delta 2) regenerate quant artifact w/ locked seed 3) run full eval across locales 4) if fails, roll kernel change on staging. tagging ops for rollback preflight.
ops-oncall: noted, will stand by for quick rollback if staging shows major regression.
jx-bot: smoke after candidate patch will trigger nightly-eval job 19045.
misaka: created internal ticket RED-ML-4971 for tracking and added checklist item: lock tokenizer hash seed in quant build.
rahul: adding unit test `tests/tokenizer/test_unicode_brackets.py` to assert U+3000..U+303F bracket atomization remains consistent across quant configs.
kai: also add a small per-locale detok regression to nightly for zh_Hant; catching these earlier would help.
sora: PR opened, will run full 2k-sample eval tomorrow morning and post results.
jx-bot: preliminary eval (candidate patch): fp16 zh_Hant BLEU=28.1, int8-rebuilt BLEU=28.0. full run scheduled.
misaka: thanks team. will watch staging and follow up if ar rtl bracket flips crop up.
